fusions.name: Numbing Bite
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Strikes with your weapon for a chilling blow that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds, with a 30% chance of [Slowed] for 3 seconds. It also leaves the target [Frostbitten] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Chill Shove
fusions.desc: Shoves out with your cold bulk, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them back 2.5 tiles, with a 50% chance of [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Torpor Shell
fusions.desc: You go still and cold: for 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

fusions.name: Winter-Proof Hide
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%, and you carry 10% frost resistance.
